art_direction.concept: Swiss Brutalism meets High-End ESG Tech
art_direction.description: Abandoning the traditional dossier look for a premium, award-winning (Awwwards) aesthetic. The design relies on 'The Anti-Default' principles: radical scale contrast, profound negative space, and kinetic typography. It blends the severe authority of regulatory frameworks with the cutting-edge appeal of modern AI platforms. The 'wow' factor comes from flawless motion choreography, high-contrast layouts, and intentional use of real photography inside sharp, unyielding geometric masks.

headings.usage: Massive, tracking-tighter headlines. Mix 200 (Light) and 800 (ExtraBold) in the same heading for visual tension.

body.usage: Clean, highly legible body text. Left-aligned always.

mono_and_data.usage: For data points, overlines, the CBAM calculator numbers, step indicators, and animated counters.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs md:text-sm font-mono tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#00E599]

surfaces.name: Crystal Glass
surfaces.usage: Sticky Nav, Floating Modals, Calculator Cards

surfaces.name: Masked Imagery
surfaces.classes: rounded-none clip-path-polygon for sharp, editorial image framing

textures: Subtle noise overlay (pointer-events-none, opacity-[0.03]) across the entire background to kill 'digital flatness'.

layouts.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard but scaled up. Use p-8, p-12, p-24, p-32. Avoid p-4 for major containers to ensure generous negative space.

grid_modes.tetris_bento: For Regulatory Reality & Sectors. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create deliberate asymmetry.
grid_modes.data_dense: For Admin Dashboard & Calculator. Tight gap-4, strict alignment, dense utility.

sections.hero: 100vh full bleed. Massive text top-left. Globe/3D canvas absolute positioned behind text or to the right.
sections.regulatory_reality: Bento grid (Tetris mode) featuring 5 region cards with sharp borders and mono typography.
sections.three_pillars: Sticky stacked cards or horizontal scroll section. Massive typography for 01, 02, 03.
sections.proof_in_numbers: Full width, huge JetBrains Mono animated counters (text-[10vw]) separated by 1px vertical borders.
sections.calculator: Two-column split layout. Left: Sticky explanatory text. Right: Interactive glassmorphic form elements.

choreography.hero_onload: Masked line-by-line reveal. Parent `overflow-hidden`, Child `initial={{ y: '100%' }} animate={{ y: 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1], staggerChildren: 0.1 }}`
choreography.scroll_reveals: Use `whileInView`. Fade in and slight translate-y. Avoid heavy rotations. Keep it sophisticated.
choreography.marquee: The 'Kinetic Texture'. Massive outline text (text-transparent stroke-white/10) running very slowly (-10px/s) behind sections.
choreography.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards: subtle border color shift to primary, image scales up 1.05x inside hidden overflow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all body text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Primary text is #FFF on #060608. Secondary text #A0A2AB on #060608.

media.treatment: Images must be wrapped in `overflow-hidden` containers. Apply `mix-blend-luminosity` and `opacity-70` for a sleek B2B look, transitioning to full color and opacity-100 on hover. Never use placeholder URLs.

hero_moment.usage: Render a dark mode, high-tech glowing globe with connection arcs to represent global supply chains. Background must be transparent (`rgba(0,0,0,0)`). Overlay behind the kinetic text.

component_instructions.forms_and_calculator: Use customized Shadcn UI. Strip out the Vercel look. Inputs should have bg-white/5, border-white/10, focus:border-[#00E599], rounded-none (sharp edges).
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Use 'Magnetic' button effect via framer-motion for the primary CTA.
component_instructions.slide_out_tray: Use Shadcn Sheet for the Programme Builder cart. Deep black background, 1px white/10 left border.
component_instructions.dossier_questionnaire: Use a stepped progress indicator (JetBrains Mono). Only one question visible at a time with smooth crossfade transitions.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid 'AI slop'. Make it Awwwards-worthy and distinctive.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., `transition: all`). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
DO NOT center align the app container. No `.App { text-align: center; }`.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. ALWAYS use Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur + semi-transparent bg) so text doesn't clash with content beneath.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (e.g., gap-12, py-32) to create luxurious negative space.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Ensure every interaction has micro-animations (hover, focus, active). Static interfaces feel dead.
Do NOT use raw HTML `<select>` or `<input type='date'>`. Use Shadcn equivalents.
